designNote: Considered a separate ClearTemporaryHitPoints command/mutation; rejected in favor of redefining amount=0 as an unconditional clear within the existing SetTemporaryHitPoints, since 0 was never a meaningful 'grant' under the higher-value-wins rule anyway (max(current, 0) was always a dead no-op for current > 0). Keeps the GraphQL contract, the frontend action, and the idempotency fingerprint all unchanged; only the domain method's behavior at exactly zero changed.
